Summer Challenge – Athletics Tournament offers fast-paced entertainment for sport enthusiasts and for the whole family as well. Challenge the world's best athletes in 20 disciplines playing alone or with your friends. The realistic graphics and amazing sound atmosphere turn your living room into a virtual sports stadium. Four uniquely designed competition areas, in which modernity and ancient world collide, wait to be conquered. Summer Challenge offers multifaceted and diversified sports with competitions up to four players, a complex single player career modus as well as online rankings in order to compete against players all around the world.
